arguments.text: Manchester City are clear favourites at 49% to win at Leeds United, a significant departure from the league baseline where away sides win only 28% of the time. The model expects a competitive but low-scoring fixture, with City's expected goals of 2.02 substantially outweighing Leeds' 1.21, and the most likely outcomes all featuring away victories. Both teams scoring appears likely at 58%, though the three most probable scorelines all feature City clean sheets, suggesting the hosts may struggle to break through despite their home advantage.
arguments.suggested_bet_reason: The model gives Manchester City 49% to win away, significantly above the 28% league baseline for away victories.
